But when the Queen asked me to serve as Senator, I couldn't refuse her.|Padmé Amidala|{{Film|II}}}} '''Réillata''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from [[Naboo]]. Born around [[51 BBY]], she twice served as the [[Monarch of Naboo|monarch]] of her people, the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]. The first time was a two-[[Standard year|year]] term in around [[36 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' when [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]—a future [[queen]] of Naboo herself—was still a young girl. Upon stepping down, she became a moderately successful [[opera]] singer. Her second term started in [[28 BBY]], after Amidala's four-year reign ended. Réillata ran again for the election, campaigning on the experience and stability her years afforded her. Although she was an older candidate than tradition dictated, she was [[Second coronation of Réillata|elected]] queen once again, beating [[Jamillia]]. ==Biography== Réillata was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[51 BBY]]. When future [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]] [[Eirtaé]] was just a [[Gender|girl]], Réillata was elected [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. Although her tenure was uncontroversial in the two [[Standard year|years]] the Queen served, Réillata decided to not run again. She was discouraged, feeling that not enough had been accomplished and that she was simply not suited for politics. Instead, she decided to resume her original passion of performing [[opera]]. Réillata went on to be a moderately successful opera [[Musician|singer]]. Years later, in the middle of a performance, Réillata realized how ridiculous her logic was. She could sing arias in front of hundreds, was a good listener and orator, and felt she could connect with many people through her confidence and charisma. Réillata spoke with her family on the idea of resuming her political career, and after [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] finished serving the second of her two terms, Réillata campaigned again to be elected Queen despite tradition dictating that only younger women should run for the office. She was elected again, beating [[Jamillia]]. During the [[Second coronation of Réillata|ceremony]] in which political power was formally passed from Amidala to Réillata, the new Queen revealed that [[Senator]] [[Oshadam]] was retiring from the [[Galactic Senate]], having served after Naboo's previous senator, [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], had been elected [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]]. She asked Amidala, a seasoned politician, to accept Royal appointment as the new senator for the [[Chommell sector]], which Amidala eventually agreed to. Like her predecessor, Réillata was served by several handmaidens, including her young [[Réillata's niece|niece]]. When Amidala briefly returned to Naboo after a [[Standard week|week]]-long stay on the planet [[Alderaan]], Réillata welcomed her and her entourage back in the [[Theed Royal Palace|palace]] [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)|throne room]]. In a private conversation between the two, Réillata encouraged Amidala to return to the Senate and explained her decision to run for queen again. [[Standard decade|Decade]]s later, Réillata was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|At least she waited until this election. It would have been an unnecessary mess if she'd run against you directly.''"
"''I know. And maybe a balance of younger and older rulers ought to be considered. Any path can be a poor one if it goes blindly in one direction.|Sabé and Padmé Amidala shortly after learning of Réillata's re-election|}} A queen nearing twenty three years old was young for most places in the galaxy, but on Naboo, Réillata was older than tradition dictated and had campaigned on experience and stability that her years had afforded her. Like her competitor Jamillia, Réillata agreed with Amidala in matters of planetary defense, specifically with projects like the [[ion pulse]] that had not been completed in Amidala's tenure. Réillata was also understanding of the time Amidala needed with her [[Naberrie family|family]] after she returned from [[Coruscant]]. As the handmaiden [[Saché]] watched Réillata's second coronation, she noted that she wore the red dress of Naboo sovereignty but thought, somewhat treasonously, that she lacked Amidala's inherit kindness. Saché was forced to muster up some grudging respect for Réillata as she managed to make her poise and steady pace look deliberate. Réillata was taller than Amidala and had short [[hair]]. ==Behind the scenes== Réillata first appeared within the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2019]] novel ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' by [[E. K. Johnston]], where she is established to have reigned after Padmé Amidala and before Jamillia. In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] started her reign immediately once [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] ended hers.[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] The actress [[Wikipedia:Arden Cho|Arden Cho]] served as ''Queen's Shadow'' author E. K.
